source_limitations: Source energy/color/type retained exactly in metadata. Unreal photometry and exposure differ; importer numeric conversions are only adjustable starting estimates.
Area disk/ellipse converted to rectangular light approximation; spot blend mapped approximately.
Blender world, fog/volume, camera, render-only moon/haze and compositing effects excluded.
Spawn clearance, player orientation, light mobility/performance/shadows and gameplay require Unreal testing.
Portable BaseColor/Roughness/tangent Normal maps, constant metallic and emission only.
Procedural noise, dirt, bump, color mixing, transmission and specialized Blender shader behavior are not automatically baked.
Normal GL textures use Unreal Flip Green Channel; validate lighting in target engine.
Two-sided foliage enabled by source material name; full subsurface/transmission requires review.
